title: Readiness check and once-only resume engine
goal: Readiness check and once-only resume engine
acceptance: At the deadline availability is inspected (not assumed); job identity rechecked; resumes once under an execution lease; outcome notified
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-13 at 0.25x from node tools/work-items.mjs calibrate (median 0.25x over 16 closed steps since 2026-11-12).
